thread_text:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@altumlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice handback & billing-owner acceptance — Altum Labs
Attachments: Altum_Billing_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for the call earlier. To get the billing and first invoices set up cleanly before your go-live, we need a quick decision on who will be the canonical invoice "publisher" (i.e., who issues the invoice file) and how you'd like to receive invoice copies going forward. Our standard flows are:

- Portal-first: Redwood publishes invoices to the Redwood Billing Portal; AP can pull or we can push an email copy to a distribution list.
- Email-first: Redwood emails PDF/UBL to your AP mailbox and optionally archives to the portal later.

For Altum, two specific asks I have so we can move to PO mapping and generation:
1) Confirm invoice publisher: "Redwood Inference" (we issue) or "Altum Labs" (you ingest and we provide unsigned invoice payload).
2) Delivery preference: Portal-only / Portal + email copy / Email + archive to portal.
3) Billing contact (name + email) to appear on the invoice and for automated ack.
4) VAT / tax evidence we should include on the invoice (VAT ID, reverse-charge note if applicable).
5) Any required PO-field mapping (PO number location on the invoice).

I've attached a short checklist (Altum_Billing_Checklist.xlsx) that lists the minimum fields. If we are authorised to publish invoices on Altum's behalf for the initial quarter (handback) we'll also need a signed mutual action plan (MAP) and your remit instructions.

Next steps: if you reply with publisher decision + delivery preference + a billing contact, we will prepare a sample invoice (with your VAT label) and distribute for sign-off.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15 if helpful.

Best,
Ava Chen
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

---

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@altumlabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@altumlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:38:12 +0200
Subject: Re: Invoice handback & billing-owner acceptance — Altum Labs

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the checklist — that helps. A few notes from procurement / legal:

1) Altum's preference is that invoices land in our AP mailbox (ap@altumlabs.com) via SFTP or secure email by default. Portal is fine as an archive, but AP needs the first-delivery copy.
2) For the initial onboarding period (first 90 days) Procurement is comfortable with Redwood acting as the invoice publisher (i.e., Redwood-originated PDF/UBL sent to AP) provided we have a signed MAP and a remit instruction. After the pilot we'll revisit canonical publisher ownership.
3) VAT: Altum is in Spain — please ensure the invoice includes our VAT: ESB23456789 and the line item that indicates reverse-charge is NOT applicable for these services (we confirmed with our tax team).
4) PO: AP will attach a standard PO number in the PO field; please map any "order_ref" to the top-right header on the PDF.

I attached the remit instructions separately (we'll send official PDF in the next message). Once we get the MAP signed and a sample invoice we can approve.

Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Altum Labs
marta.ruiz@altumlabs.com

Hi Marta —

Appreciate the clarity. To confirm Redwood's recommended approach for the pilot:

- Redwood will act as invoice publisher for Q3 onboarding window (three months). We'll generate PDF + UBL payload and deliver first copies to ap@altumlabs.com.
- We'll also post the same invoice payload to the Redwood Billing Portal for archive and optional retrieval.
- We'll include the VAT ID you provided and a visible PO field at the top-right (order_ref mapping).

I'll attach the signed MAP we discussed (MAP-Redwood-Altum-signed.docx) and include a short checklist for our billing engine to map the PO to the header. If AP confirms SFTP details later, we can switch push channel; until then we will send to ap@altumlabs.com and cc your billing contact.

Action items for Altum we still need:
- Confirm final remit PDF (so the invoice footer has the correct bank wires).
- Provide the billing contact to appear on the invoice and for automated acknowledgements.

If that sounds good I will kick off the sample invoice generation and share a DocuSign link for the MAP (or we can accept your signed copy).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
